findings.where: episodes/ep02.md「原作の食い違い」#2 /「参照画像」壺 row

findings.what: 34 all-new key_images, 0 reuse, with 踏切.base intent-only (no image).
findings.why: No shot exceeds 30s (max m03=26s), so the WAN load is feasible — but every crossing-bearing key_image must re-establish gravel/earth, two rails, black-white barrier bands, and no-lamp/sign/signal from text alone, with no base plate to pin, across 34 independent bakes.
findings.fix: Acceptable as declared; consider baking a corrected crossing plate as the first asset so the remaining key_images can pin against it and cut the text-only geography risk.

note: The design is works-level: reference keys are all real or declared-missing, place/time are single and memory is correctly not a location, and the 34-bake WAN load is feasible with no shot over 30s. The Motion character remainder and the expected per-stage checker red are understood and sequenced, not papered over. Two real gaps survive v02: the s08c/s09b palm shots missing from body_parts, and the Sachi shoe override that contradicts the measured 'reference wardrobe wins over text' rule. The 壺 is functional (empty/no-water is the point) but under-specified for a three-shot prop with no image.
